_about: Expected OUTPUTS only (Phase 2 test oracle). Thresholds live in config/assumptions.yaml; metric definitions in docs/methodology.md. Generated by fixtures/generate_expected.py, which shares no code with the analyzer.

deliberate_smells.why: Large tier (loc >= 400 and complexity > 50). OrderServices stands in for OFBiz OrderServices.java (7,516 LOC). LedgerReconciler (400, 51) sits exactly on the thresholds and MUST be flagged; StatementFormatter (399, 50) is one short of both and must NOT be.
Extreme tier (loc >= 1500 and complexity > 200). Only OrderServices; LedgerReconciler is large but not extreme.
OrderReadHelper is used by party, billing and order (fan-in) and itself reaches into party and billing (fan-out), creating module cycles order<->party and order<->billing.
Raw Connection/PreparedStatement and SQL strings inside billing business logic.
Business logic calls EntityQuery/delegator directly. Dominant OFBiz pattern.
order (the riskiest module) and common have no test evidence.
party has PartyController on jakarta.servlet and PartyLegacyHelper on javax.servlet.
Service definitions, controller events and a Groovy script carry behaviour the Java analyzer cannot see.
Definitions pointing at a missing method or at a class missing from an analysed module. syncExternalLedger points at an unanalysed module and is NOT broken.

traps_must_not_count.what: EntityQuery.use( and prepareStatement( in a Javadoc comment and a string literal must NOT be db_coupling; the Javadoc mention of InvoiceService must NOT be a dependency
import javax.sql.DataSource is a JDK package, NOT a legacy marker
high fan-in but zero fan-out, so NOT highly coupled
Java fan-in is 0 but service_fan_in 2 and controller_fan_in 1, so used=true; fan-out 13 but fan-in 0, so NOT highly coupled
boundary classes: 399/50 is not a god class; 400/51 is. No dependencies, unused.
stub declarations and calls are not db_coupling (ignored classes)
syncExternalLedger (class in an unanalysed module) is out_of_scope, not broken; interface engines are excluded from the coverage denominator
service and groovy events are counted by type but do not add controller_fan_in
